long_term_candidates.title: Stable fixture decision
long_term_candidates.content: The validator fixture must retain a reachable source.

decision_context.reason: The source makes the decision auditable across Sessions.

long_term_candidates.rationale: No current Long-term entry covers this verified fact.

long_term_candidates.title: Expanded fixture experience
long_term_candidates.content: Validate reachable evidence before promoting durable experience.
long_term_candidates.rationale: The new evidence expands one existing validation entry.

long_term_candidates.title: Consolidated fixture principle
long_term_candidates.content: Durable claims require both reachable sources and protocol validation.
long_term_candidates.rationale: Two overlapping entries form one reusable principle.

long_term_candidates.title: Existing fixture fact
long_term_candidates.content: The validator fixture has a reachable source.
long_term_candidates.rationale: The current Long-term entry already contains the same claim.

long_term_candidates.title: One-off fixture output
long_term_candidates.content: A one-off command emitted routine output.
long_term_candidates.rationale: Routine output is not useful across future Tasks.

long_term_candidates.title: Corrected fixture constraint
long_term_candidates.content: Current runtime evidence contradicts the stored constraint.
long_term_candidates.rationale: The contradiction requires review before supersession.

playbook_candidates.title: Evidence-first performance diagnosis
playbook_candidates.trigger: A user asks to diagnose a runtime performance regression.
steps: Capture runtime evidence before proposing a cause.
Run a reversible experiment against the strongest hypothesis.
Recommend a permanent change only after the experiment confirms the cause.
checks: The evidence is reachable from the source Task.
The experiment does not require a permanent change.
playbook_candidates.rationale: The executed method is reusable and no current Playbook covers it.

playbook_candidates.title: Validate protocol artifacts
playbook_candidates.trigger: A formal XiaoTao protocol artifact is about to be persisted.
steps: Run the matching artifact-triggered protocol guard.
Repair an invalid artifact once and validate it again.
Persist the canonical artifact only after validation succeeds.
checks: A second invalid result is retained with an invalid suffix.
playbook_candidates.rationale: Executed evidence adds a repair step to one current Playbook.

playbook_candidates.title: Validate and preserve protocol evidence
playbook_candidates.trigger: A formal protocol artifact and its evidence are about to be persisted.
steps: Run the matching artifact-triggered protocol guard.
Persist the canonical artifact only after validation succeeds.
checks: Every referenced source exists under the project root.
playbook_candidates.rationale: The two current Playbooks form one coherent validated procedure.

playbook_candidates.title: Run a one-off fixture command
playbook_candidates.trigger: The exact disposable fixture needs local inspection.
steps: Run the one-off command used by this Task.
playbook_candidates.rationale: The command and path are Task-specific and have no reusable workflow value.
